items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-27
items.q: I don't think he does. I've inquired a couple times, but he wasn't too free with his information.

ctx.x: He's buried in the second graveyard on St. Louis in Claymore. It's a little grave there. He has a marker on it. Someone takes care of it, but I don't know who. It's always spotless. But I think it's the Masons. He was a Mason.
Well, we can ask Buddy, the sextant over there. Do you know Buddy?
I don't think he does. I've inquired a couple times, but he wasn't too free with his information.
